audits.secondSweep: Dedicated P5/P6 sweep done. Body-part subjects checked: hands stopped L49/L281, a hand came over L189, chin hit L215, hand came back L269, face hot L289, fingers L497, Lyriel's hand L551, stomach L491/L509. Abstract-into-body settling: none found. Road/geography motion verbs checked (road ran L163/L595, road went up L563, road bent L359, hedges closing in): all standard path verbs, kept. Metaphor chains: the staff (hummed, gave it back, rose, shivered) and the contamination "it" (travels, seeps, pressed in, leaning, working) both receive repeated verbs. Both are literal in-world mechanisms and were kept on the subject-matter defense, except "nowhere to hide", which assigns intent. Receiver nouns: answer L55, stones L57, things in the satchel L127, farm L329 were killed.
audits.keepRateNote: The keep rate is above the 15% guide threshold because the chapter's subject is a sensed magical contamination moving through leylines, ward-stones, soil, water and flesh. Most inanimate-subject sentences describe that literal in-world mechanism (subject-matter defense) or involuntary bodily reactions (Pattern 8 exception).
